Lemma
[Horizontal differentiation is covariant differentiation] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0447, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0448, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0449 ↗ def:chow-ii-horizontal-frame-fields 1. appf:F.13,appf:F.14\group Frame Bundle Calculus

For every $(p,q)$-tensor $U$, \[ abla _c\! \left(U^{a_1\cdots a_q}_{b_1\cdots b_p} ight) =( abla _cU)^{a_1\cdots a_q}_{b_1\cdots b_p}. \] Thus the global fields $ abla _a$ realize the covariant derivative of tensors as ordinary directional derivatives of their frame components.
